import os
import requests


def submit_transcription(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    response = requests.post(
        f"https://{config['region']}.api.cognitive.microsoft.com/speechtotext/transcriptions:submit",
        params={'api-version': '2024-11-15'},
        headers={'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': config.get('api_key') or os.environ['AZURE_SPEECH_KEY']},
        json={'displayName': config.get('job_name', 'transcription'),
              'locale': payload['language_code'], 'contentUrls': [payload['audio_uri']]}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {'job_id': response.json()['self'], 'status': 'SUBMITTED'}

from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import List, Optional, Dict, Any

class TranscriptionPayload(BaseModel):
    audio_uri: str
    language_code: str
    display_name: Optional[str] = "transcription"
    diarization_enabled: Optional[bool] = False
    word_level_timestamps_enabled: Optional[bool] = False

class TranscriptionConfig(BaseModel):
    api_key: Optional[str] = None
    region: str = "eastus"
    job_name: Optional[str] = "transcription"

class TranscriptionJob(BaseModel):
    job_id: str
    status: str
    result_uri: Optional[str] = None

class TranscriptionResultWord(BaseModel):
    word: str
    offset: str
    duration: str

class TranscriptionResultSegment(BaseModel):
    text: str
    speaker: Optional[int] = None
    words: Optional[List[TranscriptionResultWord]] = None

class TranscriptionResult(BaseModel):
    duration: str
    combinedRecognizedPhrases: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None
    recognizedPhrases: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None

class TranslationPayload(BaseModel):
    text: str
    target_language_code: str
    source_language_code: Optional[str] = None

class ModerationPayload(BaseModel):
    text: str

class SummarizationPayload(BaseModel):
    text: str

class EmbeddingPayload(BaseModel):
    text_segments: List[str]

from speech_client import AzureSpeechClient
from speech_models import TranscriptionPayload, TranscriptionConfig, TranscriptionJob

def diarized_transcript(payload: TranscriptionPayload, config: TranscriptionConfig = None):
    config = config or TranscriptionConfig()
    client = AzureSpeechClient(config)

    properties = {
        "diarizationEnabled": True,
    }

    response_json = client.submit_transcription_job(
        display_name=payload.display_name,
        locale=payload.language_code,
        content_urls=[payload.audio_uri],
        properties=properties
    )

    job_id = response_json['self']
    status = response_json['status']
    return TranscriptionJob(job_id=job_id, status=status)

import os
import google.generativeai as genai
from speech_models import SummarizationPayload

def archive_summary(payload: SummarizationPayload):
    genai.configure(api_key=os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY"))
    if not os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY"):
        raise ValueError("Gemini API key not found. Please set GEMINI_API_KEY environment variable.")

    model = genai.GenerativeModel('gemini-pro')
    prompt = f"Summarize the following text:\n\n{payload.text}"
    response = model.generate_content(prompt)
    
    return {"summary": response.text}
